sqlReaderQuery.value:
select fulldate
from 
    eds.eds_ctl ect
inner join 
    eds.date_dim dd
    on 
    ect.FMS_Date=dd.previous_business_day and dd.business_day_flag='Y'

activities.name: Iterate Execution of Process Date Range
